title: Wie fühlt sich unsere Marke an und wie verhält sie sich?
slide_intent: Translate a brand promise into recognizable traits so designers can connect tone with visible choices.
strategic_value: Linking performance, responsibility and care to examples can help DB maintain a coherent stance across media.
demonstration: Three promise words precede four photographed personality traits, followed by a tonality explanation and a collage of brand ingredients.
practical_value: Evaluate the same composition against the promise, behavioral traits and visual tone.

content_islands.name: Promise
content_islands.spec: Present Leistung, Verantwortung and Fürsorge as three parallel cards below the rationale.

content_islands.name: Personality traits
content_islands.spec: Pair four operational photographs with consequent, dynamic, responsible and customer-oriented explanations.

content_islands.name: Tonality and collage
content_islands.spec: Explain moving, clear and confident tone before the mixed image/type/graphic board.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects tone to orientation, trust, courage and a consistent brand experience.
reference_purposes.Expression: The four photographs and final collage demonstrate how personality can appear visually.
reference_purposes.Application: The section supplies questions for evaluating whether a project reflects the stated stance.
